title: MoRA: Missing Modality Low-Rank Adaptation for Visual Recognition
boundary: Pretrained vision-language adaptation, not verified OSRAM feature-front-end improvement; different from MICCAI2024 same-name MoRA.

title: Decoupling Common and Unique Representations for Multimodal Self-supervised Learning
boundary: Representation objective including intra-modal anti-collapse, not two arbitrary MLP branches. Original radar/optical,RGB/elevation,RGB/depth; no OSRAM score guarantee.

title: Boosting Multimodal Learning via Disentangled Gradient Learning
boundary: Training gradient-routing mechanism, not standalone inference block. Must not naively erase CHM future-task gradients; regression/missing adaptation unverified.
